_comment: Global voice config for the ElevenLabs pipeline. null / "TODO_..." = not yet confirmed; the validator refuses to call the API until they are filled. IDs and model were read from the account via the API (voice discovery, 2026-10-11); eleven_v4 is the model recorded in the account's history for the EP.01 takes. eleven_v4 does not support style or speaker boost (GET /v1/models), so those keys are omitted. stability 0 / similarity_boost 0 for both voices is the user's decision (matches the EP.01 examples take). Unverified: whether eleven_v4 accepts the key name similarity_boost (history calls it 'similarity') and supports with-timestamps - check on the first smoke test.
